#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <unordered_map>

using namespace std;

int advance(int s, int x, int m, int n) {
    if (s < m) {
        return (s + x) % n;
    } else {
        return (s + n - x) % n;
    }
}

int advanceFull(int s, int m, int n) {
    for (int i = n - 1; i > 0; --i) {
        s = advance(s, i, m, n);
    }
    return s;
}

int main() {
    int n, m, s;
    long long t;
    cin >> n >> m >> s >> t;
    s--; // convert to 0-index

    while (t % n != 0) {
        s = advance(s, (int)(t % n), m, n);
        t--;
    }

    long long cant = t / n;
    vector<int> order;
    unordered_map<int, int> seen;

    while (cant > 0 && seen.find(s) == seen.end()) {
        seen[s] = order.size();
        order.push_back(s);
        s = advanceFull(s, m, n);
        cant--;
    }

    if (cant > 0) {
        int start = seen[s];
        long long cycleLen = order.size() - start;
        long long total = cant % cycleLen;
        for (long long i = 0; i < total; ++i) {
            s = advanceFull(s, m, n);
        }
    }

    cout << s + 1 << endl;

    return 0;
}
